nodes.description: State variable holding the POOH token contract reference; target of external buy/exit/dividend calls.
State variable storing the lottery owner address, set from msg.sender in the constructor.
Boolean state variable gating public participation via the isOpenToPublic modifier.
State variable counting accumulated tickets; incremented by payable deposits.
State variable holding the pseudo-randomly generated winning ticket number.
Untrusted caller address used for ownership, human check, deposits and payouts.
Untrusted transaction origin used in the onlyHuman modifier comparison.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used as randomness seed for the winning number.
External payable call purchasing POOH tokens with the deposit; potential reentrancy entry point.

ETH transfer to the winner; external call occurring after external POOH interactions.
ETH transfer of the 10% developer fee; external call to an arbitrary address.
Arbitrary external ERC20 transfer call on a user-supplied token address.
Arithmetic division computing the number of extra tickets from the deposit value.
Arithmetic subtraction of the reserved 0.05 ETH from the balance before payout.
Arithmetic division computing the 10% lottery fee donated to the developer.
Arithmetic accumulation of ticket numbers based on the deposit amount.
Arithmetic increment of the ticket counter for a base entry.
Weak randomness derivation from timestamp and difficulty; miner-manipulable outcome.

Ownership authorization check used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Payable public entry point that buys tokens, tracks tickets, triggers payouts and resets the lottery.

Internal function computing and transferring the 10% fee to the owner.

Constructor initializing the POOH reference, public flag and owner.
Payable fallback function accepting plain ETH transfers into the pool.

edges.reason: owner state variable is assigned from the untrusted msg.sender in the constructor.
msg.sender is compared against owner inside the onlyOwner require.
tx.origin is compared with msg.sender in the onlyHuman require, an origin-based authorization pattern.
block.timestamp feeds the weak randomness computation of the winning number.
deposit performs an external payable call into the POOH contract before later payouts.
deposit calls the external POOH.exit() which can re-enter before transfers.
deposit re-buys POOH with the whole balance via an external call.
deposit invokes the internal payWinner routine when the winning condition is met.
deposit invokes the internal payDev routine to collect the lottery fee.
deposit calls resetLottery after a winning round completes.
deposit passes msg.value into the extra-ticket division.
deposit performs the ticketNumber accumulation based on the deposit value.
deposit increments ticketNumber for base entries.
local customerAddress is assigned from the untrusted msg.sender.
local extraTickets receives the result of the division.
extraTickets is added into the ticketNumber accumulator.
ticketNumber state variable is updated with the accumulated tickets.
ticketNumber state variable is incremented by one.
payWinner transfers ETH to the winner, an external call to a user-controlled address.
payWinner computes the prize through SafeMath.sub on the contract balance.
local balance receives the subtracted prize amount.
the computed local balance parameterizes the winner transfer amount.
payDev transfers ETH to the developer, an external call to a privileged address.
payDev computes the fee through SafeMath.div on the contract balance.
local balance receives the divided fee amount.
the computed local balance parameterizes the developer transfer amount.
resetLottery writes the timestamp-derived pseudo-random winning number.
the pseudo-random result is stored into the winningNumber state variable.
resetLottery resets the ticketNumber state variable.
constructor sets the owner state variable from msg.sender.
constructor sets the POOH contract reference.
constructor initializes the openToPublic flag to false.
openToThePublic sets the openToPublic state variable to true.
openToThePublic triggers a lottery reset after opening.
returnAnyERC20Token makes an external transfer call on a caller-supplied token contract.
tokenAddress parameter determines the external contract invoked.
tokenOwner parameter determines the transfer recipient.
tokens parameter determines the transferred amount.
the onlyOwner modifier enforces the owner equality require.
owner state variable is used on the right side of the authorization require.
aContract parameter is validated inside the notPooh modifier.
poohContract state variable is the forbidden address compared in notPooh.
openToPublic state variable gates execution in the isOpenToPublic modifier.
the onlyHuman modifier enforces the msg.sender == tx.origin require.
deposit is guarded by the origin-based onlyHuman modifier.
deposit is guarded by the isOpenToPublic modifier.
returnAnyERC20Token is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
returnAnyERC20Token removes the POOH token from the rescue scope.
openToThePublic is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
resetLottery requires the lottery to be open to the public.
myTokens reads the POOH contract reference.
myDividends reads the POOH contract reference.
deposit uses the poohContract state variable for its external calls.
winner parameter is the beneficiary of the payout transfer in payWinner.

normalization_plan.reason: aContract is only consumed by the notPooh modifier and should be folded into that core function node.
tokenAddress only flows into the external ERC20 transfer operation and can be merged into it.
tokenOwner only flows into the external ERC20 transfer operation and can be merged into it.
tokens only flows into the external ERC20 transfer operation and can be merged into it.
winner is a transient parameter of payWinner and should be absorbed into that function node.
dev is a transient parameter of payDev and should be absorbed into that function node.
customerAddress is a temporary alias of msg.sender inside deposit and should be folded into deposit.
extraTickets is only the result of the ticket division operation and can be merged into it.
the local balance in payWinner is only the subtraction result and can be merged into that operation.
the local balance in payDev is only the division result and can be merged into that operation.
